dedupe_keys.name: dvb t2 second generation terrestrial tv specification etsi en 302 755 and ts 102 755

description: DVB-T2 is the second generation digital terrestrial television standard of the DVB Project, used for terrestrial TV in the United Kingdom, much of Europe, Africa and parts of Asia. Its core specification defines the frame structure, channel coding and modulation: OFDM with a range of FFT sizes and guard intervals, LDPC and BCH forward error correction, rotated constellations up to 256-QAM, multiple physical layer pipes, multiple-input single-output transmission for single frequency networks, and the T2-Lite profile for low-capacity mobile use added in version 1.3.1 (2012). The standard is published by ETSI as EN 302 755 (version 1.4.1 of 2015) and, from February 2023, as technical specification TS 102 755 V1.1.1, preceded by the DVB BlueBook A182 draft; related DVB documents cover implementation guidelines, the T2 modulator interface (T2-MI) and transmitter signatures (T2-SIG). Coverage: all countries using DVB-T2, specification editions from 2009 to 2023. Format and access: PDF from the ETSI deliver server and the DVB website, free of charge. Caveats: a specification, not measurement data; network planning parameters are set in ITU-R and national rules, not here; automated requests to the ETSI server were refused, so file access was checked through the DVB page. Simulation uses: parameters for coverage, capacity and interference models of broadcast networks, single frequency network design, and energy and capacity scenarios for network renewal. Related records: ATSC 3.0 is the North American counterpart, the ITU BR IFIC holds GE06 plan assignments, and the UK Future of TV Distribution evidence discusses a DVB-T2 rebuild.
